items.heading: OpenVibe.Billing (alpha, shadow)
items.quote: OpenVibe.Billing W8: balanced append-only journal, provider receipts, subscriptions, payouts, freeze, reconciliation and the Live import (ADR-012)

items.heading: OpenVibe.Chat service
items.quote: Chat service: Live's chat behind a service boundary (roadmap Wave 6)

items.heading: Community forum and comments
items.quote: Wave 5: typed comment threads, forum (spaces/threads/posts), Discord relay, Pulse

items.heading: OpenVibe.Contracts first release
items.quote: v0.1.0: first contracts (subject, legacy identity map, service-token claims, entity ref, problem, service manifest, capability, event envelope, media ref)

items.heading: OpenVibe.Events service
items.quote: Events service: durable store, publish API, signed delivery with retry/DLQ/replay, SSE realtime gateway, client library

items.heading: Live release prompts
items.quote: GET /release.json; openvibe-shared v1.2.1 (the navbar loads release-watch.js: open tabs are prompted after a deploy and never reloaded while watching, broadcasting or typing)

items.heading: Media canonical object model
items.quote: Canonical object model (Wave 4): media_objects with locations, relationships, variants, jobs, retention holds and the public-size invariant; vods/clips/files/screenshot pastes become projections via object_id

items.heading: Network sign-in everywhere
items.quote: Verify-email page, sign-in everywhere, cross-site history, linked services for every site, navbar brand + modular menus

items.heading: openvibe-publishing 0.1.0
items.quote: openvibe-publishing 0.1.0: shared publishing packages (revisions, schedule, taxonomy, citations, media, discussion, seo gate, authorship, index hooks, ssr) with the two-products exit proof

items.heading: openvibe-sdk 0.1.0
items.quote: openvibe-sdk 0.1.0: core client, auth, registry, identity, modules, events, realtime, media, community and a mock platform

items.heading: OpenVibe.Search service
items.quote: Search service: index documents with revision ordering and tombstones, event inbox, permission-aware FTS5 query API, removal events through an outbox

items.heading: openvibe-shared 1.0.0
items.quote: First release from its own repository.

items.heading: Tools durable jobs
items.quote: Durable jobs on Img, Audio and Docs: /api/v1/jobs with SSE progress, cancel, reattach, idempotency keys and owner scoping; results can be Media objects
